title: Unable to use gemini-3.5-flash via VertexAI after v0.45.1

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear report of a regression in v0.45.1 where using gemini-3.5-flash with Vertex AI authentication fails. Sufficient environment and reproduction details are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is a localized logic update in packages/core/src/config/config.ts to ensure Vertex AI authentication maps gemini-3.5-flash to SECONDARY_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL ('gemini-3-flash') in hasGemini35FlashGAAccess().

summary.problem: Using model gemini-3.5-flash via Vertex AI auth method fails after v0.45.1.
summary.root_cause: In hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() within packages/core/src/config/config.ts, authType is checked for USE_GEMINI, but non-GEMINI auth types fall back to setting flash models to 'gemini-3.5-flash'. Vertex AI backends require 'gemini-3-flash' (SECONDARY_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL) instead of 'gemini-3.5-flash'.
summary.context: Vertex AI backend endpoints do not expect the string 'gemini-3.5-flash' and instead expect 'gemini-3-flash' as represented by SECONDARY_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL.

steps: In hasGemini35FlashGAAccess(), add a branch for authType === AuthType.USE_VERTEX_AI to call setFlashModels(SECONDARY_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL, SECONDARY_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL) when hasAccess is true.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() is called with authType === AuthType.USE_VERTEX_AI, DEFAULT_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL and PREVIEW_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL are set to SECONDARY_GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_MODEL ('gemini-3-flash').
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts verifying that when authType is AuthType.USE_VERTEX_AI and hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() returns true, DEFAULT_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL and PREVIEW_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL are set to 'gemini-3-flash'.
